newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares hit peaks, seen rising more.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares hit peaks, seen rising more.

text.p: Shares surged to fresh highs, lifted by the strength of European markets and Wall Street, the buoyant dollar and the hunger of domestic investors for stock.

*The PSI index jumped 1.3 percent to 7,995.39 after earlier hitting a record high of 8,013.04. Despite having risen nearly nine percent since the start of the month, traders said the market was likely to continue firm on Wednesday, particularly if the dollar remains strong.
*Analysts say that investment funds are flush with cash that has been switched away from fixed-term deposits by investors looking for a better return.
*Several shares hit all-time highs, including Portugal Telecom, Banco Pinto & Sotto Mayor, Banco Totta & Acores and Cimpor.

*According to a report Salomon Brothers, the Portuguese market offers good opportunities for longer term gain given the ambitious privatisation programme, monetary union and Portugal's coming promotion to developed market on the Morgan Stanley indices.
*Portugal Telecom closed 2.4 percent higher at 7,630 escudos on a day when Merrill Lynch announced the launch of a million UK-style warrants on the company's stock.
